name: Pixel Buddy
tagline: A free companion for a kinder workday, on the desktop and in Chrome. It sits near the corner of your screen, leads you through short breaks and helps you remember your water.

updates.title: Pixel Buddy 1.4: break streaks and quiet during any call
updates.body: Pixel Buddy now keeps a weekly history and counts your break streaks. On macOS it notices a call in any app that is using the microphone, without ever opening the microphone itself, and holds reminders until the call ends. The Chrome extension gained an on/off switch and live timers in its settings.

updates.title: Break notes, buddy moods and quiet during calls
updates.body: When a break is due you can jot down what you were doing, and the buddy shows it when you are back. Versions 1.2 and 1.3 also added quiet during calls, a setting for how long without input counts as away, buddy moods, and a fix for Open at Login.
